evidence: docs/program/calc-core.md#Canonical font-family values and ODF metadata (task135)
semantic.justification: Ports the supported Writer script/language default-font decision and keeps output-device resolution behind an injected contract. Task135: Stores the selected device adapter family in the actual font value, matching native OutputDevice OnlyOne selection responsibility; complete device service remains unported. Task135 preserves the five native SvxFontItem fields and original value defaults/constructors/copies/setters/equality/hash using existing SAL/o3tl. Writer state and ODF consumers use the single shared value owner; browser presentation and resource aliases stay at their existing boundaries. Native Any FontDescriptor, localized presentation, full font/device/config services and Calc DocPool/document/UI/ODS remain pending. Existing status/history and conscious save/open/recovery deviations are retained; no broad parity promotion or custom lifetime engine. Task165 replaces hardcoded Writer role-family lists and permissive CSS check presence tests with a generic DefaultFontType/prepared Locale browser binding. Existing source-configured lists, UTF16 tokens and search-name normalization match actual registered FontFace families; synchronous queries require loaded faces and async preparation loads all faces of candidate families in order, continuing after failures. Writer owns its native text/heading/FIXED role mapping; main awaits font preparation before mounting document factories. CSS descriptor decoding preserves registered family names. Browser/system fonts outside the registered FontFaceSet are not guessed or permission-enumerated. Full physical best-match/substitution, user configuration overrides, remaining Font attributes and Writer legacy requested-family fallback policy are not represented by this bounded device; Calc document/UI/ODS remain pending. No fake PhysicalFontCollection, native compiler/probe or lifetime manager.
